prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1004; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left, and reports right shoulder pain since the impact. The mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the shoulder injury described. Over the course of 20 visits, care followed a typical progression of physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise instruction, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved. Examination shows findings that support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion on elevation, while other orthopedic and neurological tests remain within normal limits. Review of the patient's history notes a minor strain in the same region several years earlier, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billed services are documented individually, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Current assessment is a resolving shoulder strain, with continued home exercise and reassessment as needed.
